summary: Verified the FriendPlace rebrand code hygiene per review request. Frontend-only test. Executed: (1) grep across all .tsx/.ts for 'youbelong' — 27 matches, categorised each; (2) visual load + DOM innerText inspection of all requested screens (/auth/welcome, /auth/login, /invite/[id], /onboarding, /home, /profile, /founders, /founders/info, /lounge, /friends, /settings, /edit-profile) via mobile viewport (390x844), including a demo login as maggie; (3) verified app.json (expo.name, CFBundleDisplayName, CFBundleName all == 'FriendPlace'); (4) opened /assets/brand/*.png files to inspect asset contents. RESULT: 24 of 27 grep hits are internal-only (JS imports, component/testID names, AsyncStorage keys, comments, storage prefixes) and are PASSING per user's stated scope. 3 hits are USER-VISIBLE bugs: welcome.tsx and invite/[id].tsx render youbelong-logo.png as an ImageBackground at 18% opacity, and the big YOUBELONG wordmark IS faintly visible on both screens (visually confirmed on the /invite/... screenshot — 'Y O' letters bleed through around the Create Profile button). Additionally admin/flyer.tsx names the downloaded PNG 'youbelong-flyer-*.png' — user-visible filename on disk. LATENT ASSET BUG: assets/brand/friendplace-logo.png still visually renders the YOUBELONG wordmark despite its FriendPlace filename — if a future dev swaps to it thinking it is clean, they'll ship YOUBELONG. All DOM-text checks on the twelve visited screens returned clean; FriendPlace branding renders correctly everywhere (headers, ShareYouBelong component, Welcome hero, Founding Members card, tab labels).

ui_bugs.issue: Uses `require('@/assets/brand/youbelong-logo.png')` as ImageBackground (opacity 0.18). The large YOUBELONG wordmark inside the asset is visible in the middle of the welcome screen — exactly the kind of user-facing brand leak this test was created to catch. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth/welcome.tsx:68

Same youbelong-logo.png used as ImageBackground on the invite landing page. Confirmed visually: 'Y O' letters render behind the CTA buttons on mobile viewport. Reference: /app/frontend/app/invite/[id].tsx:128
Downloaded flyer PNG is named 'youbelong-flyer-{venue}.png' / 'youbelong-flyer.png'. This is a user-visible filename saved to the admin's disk. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/flyer.tsx:62

LATENT: the asset file is named friendplace-logo.png but the raster image itself still displays 'YOUBELONG — Find your people.' text. Currently unreferenced, so it does not affect any live screen — but it is a trap. Anyone who swaps welcome.tsx/invite/[id].tsx over to this filename (a reasonable-looking fix) will still ship YOUBELONG.

rca_of_issue: The rebrand pass updated all Text/JSX strings and app.json labels but missed the raster asset itself. /app/frontend/assets/brand/youbelong-logo.png is a 528KB PNG with the words 'YOUBELONG — Find your people.' baked into the pixels. Because it is drawn as an ImageBackground at opacity 0.18 on a dark navy screen, the letters are subtle but plainly readable in the middle of both the welcome and invite screens (visually confirmed in /tmp/invite_screen.png captured during this test). Reproduction: open https://belong-together.preview.emergentagent.com/auth/welcome or /invite/anything at mobile viewport 390x844 → visible 'Y O' letters in the background. Mitigation: remove the ImageBackground (recommended — the solid navy #0E1B3D already looks polished) or point require() at friendplace-app-icon.png (the clean butterfly with no wordmark). Do NOT swap to friendplace-logo.png — that raster still says YOUBELONG.
